test_case_name: Accept all cookies on the news page

intents.intent: Click the 'Acconsento' button to accept all cookies
And then check that the cookie banner is dismissed and cookies are accepted

test_case_name: Close the cookie banner on the news page

intents.intent: Click the button with id 'cookie-chiudi' to close the cookie banner

test_case_name: Login as guest on the news page (desktop)

And then check that the guest user is logged in or receives an appropriate message
